target: cobolwork gate as first implemented: lib/gate.mjs, the gate command in bin/cobolwork.mjs, and what it needed from lib/diff.mjs (withRefs, keepScans, copied), lib/kernel/identity.mjs (pairingKeys, codeLines), lib/dataflow.mjs (listSources, exported kind tables), lib/sets/flow.mjs and lib/scan.mjs (listings carried, not printed)
context: Adversarial pass after bifocal and two overloop passes on docs/spec/remediation-gate.md. 27 tests in test/gate.test.mjs passed on first run; each fixed finding below has a test or a spec line. The reviewed repository, its file names, its patch and its PATH-adjacent files are assumed hostile; the operator who runs the gate is not.

1_network_security.finding: A bare 'cobc' is looked for in the working directory first on Windows
1_network_security.detail: Closed as designed: PATH is walked by hand, relative and in-tree entries are skipped, and the compiler is spawned by absolute path with cwd set to the temp directory. G3.2 holds it. No change.

1_network_security.finding: cobc reads whatever absolute path a COPY names
1_network_security.detail: -fsyntax-only writes nothing and the gate keeps only the exit status, so a COPY '/etc/passwd' discloses nothing. No change.

1_network_security.finding: File names are repository-chosen text on the way to a model
1_network_security.detail: Capped at 120 characters and passed through printable, which strips control and bidirectional characters but not words. repositoryText names the fields; the envelope is commitwork's to apply. Held as designed (bifocal F2).

2_performance.finding: Up to 50 programs x 2 sides x a 60 s timeout is 100 minutes
2_performance.detail: A copybook that 50 programs copy, and a source crafted to hang cobc, holds the gate for well over an hour; the API design queues heavy jobs one at a time, so it holds every other one too. FIX: one budget for the whole compile check (10 minutes); past it, compile is null and says why.

2_performance.finding: Every changed program and copybook is line-diffed only to decide that it changed
2_performance.detail: Whether a file changed is a byte comparison; the line diff is needed only for the target's own files and the files of listed sinks and sources. FIX: changedFiles compares bytes.

2_performance.finding: Time is (n+m) x D; a 200,000-line pair at D = 2,000 is 400 million comparisons
2_performance.detail: Memory is bounded by the D cap; time is not bounded by line count. FIX: a pair past 200,000 lines is too large to attribute, like one past 2,000 edits.

2_performance.finding: Scopes are tokenised a second time for files that hold findings
2_performance.detail: stampFingerprints computed the same parts moments earlier. Accepted: bounded by files with findings, and caching across calls would make identity stateful.

3_race_conditions.finding: The working tree is read by the scan, again by the line diff, and again by the compiler
3_race_conditions.detail: Several sessions write this project's working tree. A file that changes between the scan and the line diff makes the verdict describe a state that never existed as a whole. The worst outcome traced is a wrong reason rather than a wrong pass, since a pass needs the scan and the diff to agree, but the document still claims a snapshot it did not take. FIX: the spec tells the pipeline to commit the draft in its scratch worktree and gate --head <sha>; the working tree stays supported for a person at a terminal.

4_defects.finding: An incomplete base scan reads as a wrong fingerprint
4_defects.detail: If the memory guard stopped the base scan before it reached the target, the error says the base does not hold the fingerprint. FIX: the message says the base scan was incomplete when it was.

4_defects.finding: A diff rule's reason printed its id
4_defects.detail: diff's rules are not in the scan's catalogue. Fixed before this pass: ruleText reads DIFF_RULES too.

5_coherence.finding: --baseline and --no-baseline are accepted and do nothing
5_coherence.detail: The gate never applies a baseline, by design (a suppression is not a fix). FIX: refused, as --only and --repos are.

5_coherence.finding: The example document lacks summary.mode and summary.coverageIncomplete

6_data_integrity.finding: For evidence other than path, 'the patch changed the target's file' is a text fact
6_data_integrity.detail: A construct rule's absence is the engine's own statement that the construct is gone, so the text fact only guards against a finding that left for no reason. A construct rule that reads another file (the callee's declared length) can stop firing through that file while the patch touches the target's file trivially. Accepted: a changed callee declaration is how that construct is fixed. Recorded, not changed.

6_data_integrity.finding: Correct on the cases tested; the backtrack reads a window of each step's diagonals
6_data_integrity.detail: Held by a unit test (a reworded line is deleted and inserted; a pair past the bound is null) and by every G scenario that reads changed lines.

ring1_apiContract.note: gateTrees and gateRefs mirror diffTrees and diffRefs; the compiler is a port, injected in tests. The document is additive and schemaVersion 3.

ring1_5_errorMessages.note: Exit 2 messages go through printable in the CLI's catch. The EGATETARGET message is improved above.

ring1_6_backwardsCompat.note: HAZOP on the surfaces this touched: MORE (diff gains keepScans, scanAll gains listSinks/listSources): opt-in, non-enumerable, a test holds scanAll's JSON byte-identical. OTHER THAN (fingerprint refactor): partsOf computes the same inputs, identity.test.mjs and every baseline test hold the values. NO: nothing removed. SOURCE_KINDS and SINK_KINDS newly exported.

ring1_7_semantic.note: diff's document and exit codes unchanged; withRefs is diffRefs' old body.

ring2_outerBoundary.note: git absent: withRefs throws EDIFFREF, exit 2. cobc absent: not compiled. cobc slow: the per-run timeout, and now a total budget. Memory reserve reached: coverage null, undecided. Killed mid-run: materialised copies of the source stay in the temp directory until the OS clears it, as they do for diff.

blindSpots.configurationRigidity: [CHECKED] MAX_EDIT 2,000, MAX_COMPILES 50, MAX_REASONS 20, the 60 s per-compile timeout and the new 10-minute budget are constants the spec names
blindSpots.gracefulDegradation: [CHECKED] every missing dependency degrades to null or not compiled, never to pass
blindSpots.errorCatchingCompleteness: [CHECKED] file reads in codeLines, changes, compileCheck and findCobc are caught; spawnSync does not throw; the only throw is EGATETARGET, which the CLI turns into exit 2
